The $50,000,000 figure in the current draft exceeds that authorization. My note on this has not yet been circulated, so you're all hearing it now for the first time. We cannot proceed with sign-off on a $50,000,000 issue; the principal amount must be revised down to $42,000,000 to match the board's authorization.

Those two elements are essential conditions for the label.
